notes.title: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4 - Patch 7 (Mar 13, 2025)
notes.content:

[list]

notes.title: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4 - Patch 6 (Mar 6, 2025)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks for all of your continued feedback around Chapter 4 and the recent patches on social, Steam, and Discord! We have another patch here for you today, focusing mostly on bug fixes, visual glitches, and boss fight adjustments.

[h3]PATCH NOTES:[/h3]

- Multiple levels split into smaller sub-levels to address overall game performance
- Fixed several checkpoint issues
- Addressed multiple collision issues where players could get stuck or moved out of bounds
- [spoiler]Doey Boss Pit / Boss Fight[/spoiler]:
-- Fixed an issue where an invisible shield was preventing [spoiler]Doey's Dough Barrage attack[/spoiler] from reaching the player
-- Added additional effects to better highlight [spoiler]which of Doey's heads to target during the Tendril Grab attack[/spoiler]
-- Updated [spoiler]Doey's behavior when transitioning to ranged state with a canister lodged in his body[/spoiler]
-- Made [spoiler]Doey's burrow more obvious and showing its effect before he burrows out[/spoiler]
-- Addressed several issues that were preventing [spoiler]Doey from chasing the player in the pit[/spoiler]
-- Fixed an issue that could cause players to lose their right hand during the [spoiler]Doey Boss Fight[/spoiler]
-- Reduced the timer on LN2 depots after removing a canister
-- Tuning and balance pass for [spoiler]Doey[/spoiler]
-- Fixed an issue where [spoiler]Doey[/spoiler] started chasing the player while the loading screen was displayed
-- Adjusted the player crawl speed during the [spoiler]Doey chase sequence[/spoiler]
- [spoiler]No Man's Land / Yarnaby Boss Fight[/spoiler]:
-- Fixed an issue where Yarnaby could potentially become stuck in hidey holes
-- Addressed an issue where Yarnaby would vent back to the top room when the player is in the main area
-- Fixed several issues where Yarnaby could grab players through walls
-- Made several updates to significantly increase the consistency of Yarnaby’s behavior across multiple plays:
--- Yarnaby will move to the search location in the conveyor section even if the player makes noise
--- Removed 3 AI vent locations from the level
--- Yarnaby is more consistently present around the player throughout the level, especially in the machine puzzle room
--- Yarnaby always travels to the bunker section after the player lowers the bridge
-- Further navmesh improvements for Yarnaby
- Revised Yarnaby's death sequence
- Doctor's Headquarters / Doctor's Boss Fight:
-- Further navmesh improvements for the Doctor's minions
-- Tuning and balance pass for the Doctor
-- Fixed an issue where the Doctor minions would stay active after defeating the Doctor
Safe Haven:
-- Fixed an issue that was preventing players from pulling out the square piece from the generator
-- Gave Boogie Bot his controller
-- Added child photos to the Save Haven Shrine
-- Added a breathing shader to the critters in Save Haven
--- Fixed an issue where the Ollie VHS tape on was red instead of beige
- Fixed a crash that occurred when attempting to retrieve the hand attached to the box after the Yarnaby chase
- Fixed an issue where [spoiler]Doey[/spoiler] would not throw the lever off the tower if players had not entered the yard before the new objective appeared
- Fixed an issue where Barry's cart can move off the pressure plate after activation and get stuck in Wasterwater Plant
- Doctor's Domain
-- Fixed an issue where the plug started out stretched across the room and was unable to be grabbed
-- Fixed an issue where the plug can clip through the door and become inaccessible
- Adjusted the hand magnets on gear receivers to make the gears more grabbable
- Added colors to the poster for the pipe puzzle in the Foundation
- Fixed an issue in the Foundation where the gas appeared to flow in the wrong direction
- Fixed an issue that allowed players to bypass the critter attack in the Toy Graveyard
- Fixed an issue in the Toy Graveyard where the critter on the truck would get stuck and do nothing
- Added additional toy types to the critter attack in the Toy Graveyard
- Tuning and balance pass for the Critter Horde in Prison Cell Blocks
- Fixed an issue where Yarnaby would not stop clawing the vent in Containment Zone
- Fixed an issue in Level 2 where the first note was not highlighted and could not be picked up when hitting 'E'
- Fixed an issue where players cannot pick up the tape under the bed in Save Haven when hitting 'E'
- Fixed an issue where players could not pick up the purple table in the Foundation when hitting 'E'
- Fixed an issue where the Doctor's awakening VHS tape was not interactable when hitting 'E'
- Fixed an issue with the key hanging in the cell in the Toy Graveyard was not interactable when hitting 'E'
- Fixed an issue where the Doctor's subtitles disappear near the Vital Systems Room
- Multiple fixes for assets popping in and out
- Fixed several audio issues
- Updated end of game credits

notes.title: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4 - Patch 5 (Feb 14, 2025)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks for all of your feedback around Chapter 4 and the recent patches on social, Steam, and Discord! We have another patch here for you today, focusing mostly on bug fixes, visual glitches, and boss fight adjustments.

[h3]PATCH NOTES:[/h3]
- Added a pop-up notification letting players know that they need to update to DirectX12.
- Fixed an issue where restarting a checkpoint caused the objective noise to stack and get louder.
- Fixed an issue where reloading checkpoints interfered with the flashlight tutorial pop-up.
- Moved safe volumes further into hiding spots during the Yarnaby Boss Fight.
- Resolved a bug where a non moving Yarnaby would spawn if the player dies multiple times.
- Fixed an issue where if a player was in a sidle spot and killed by Yarnaby the jumpscare would break.
- Resolved an issue that was preventing saws from resetting if barely pulled in the [spoiler]Doey Boss Fight.[/spoiler]
- Fixed an issue where canisters would try to go back into their receiver and instead float.
- Resolved an issue where Spanish VO is heard instead of Portuguese VO during the [spoiler]Doey death scene.[/spoiler]
- Fixed an issue where Doey's teeth did not properly display.
- Fixed an bug where Kissy's eyelids are offset.

notes.title: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4 - Patch 4 (Feb 7, 2025)
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!  As always we appreciate your patience and feedback as the team continues to work on Chapter 4. This patch continues our tuning for the Doctor and addresses several issues with the Baba Chops encounter.  Check out the patch notes for details:

Mob Entertainment

notes.title: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4 - Patch 3 (Feb 4, 2025)
notes.content:
Hi everyone! As always, thanks for your patience and feedback as we continue to work on Chapter 4. This patch wraps up our work on the Yarnaby sequence, as well as shifting some focus onto the Doey and Doctor sequences. Check out the patch notes for details:

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
- Yarnaby hiding spots should be significantly safer now.
- Additional fixes for Yarnaby spawn camping.
- Additional balance fixes for Yarnaby' sequence.
- Fixed a bug where the bridge during the Yarnaby sequence would not always work.
- [spoiler]Elevator after Doey transformation / chase should now be open.[/spoiler]
- Fixed an issue where Doctor minions were active after [spoiler]the Doctors' death.[/spoiler]
- Fixed TVs in Doctor's Intro and Doctor's hallway.
- Fixed an issue where going into deep crouch or using slides would cause the camera to spin.
- Fixed an issue where the rotate item functionality stopped working after player death.
- Fixed an issue where players could easily fall out of the cable car.
- Added a kill volume to the zip line so players no longer fall below the map.
- Additional UI improvements.

Thanks,
Mob Entertainment

notes.title: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4 - Patch 2 (Feb 1, 2025)
notes.content:
Hi everyone! New patch coming in hot today! Thanks for your patience and feedback on our first patch. We've done some additional adjustments to the Yarnaby boss fight, as well as fixed some various other bugs and crashes. Check out the patch notes for details:

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
- Additional fixes to Yarnaby spawn camping.
- Additional fixes to hiding spaces for the Yarnaby Boss Fight. More fixes to come in a following patch.
- Additional balance changes to Yarnaby's difficulty.
- Fixed a bug where the door to the Vital Center remained open, allowing players to backtrack and lose progress.
- Fixed a crash with jumpscares.
- Fixed a VRAM crash.
- Fixed additional reflection issues.
- Fixed issues with PLAs.
- Additional UI improvements.

There will be additional fixes coming early next week to the Yarnaby sequence, as well as fixes for the Doctor and the Doctor's minions.

Thanks,
Mob Entertainment

notes.title: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4 - Patch 1 (1/31/2025)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! First off, we're so excited about the reception Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4 has received so far. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you! Over the next few weeks, the development team will be working hard to squash bugs and implement QOL improvements. We heard you, so this initial patch is mostly focused around the Yarnaby sequence.

[h3]PATCH NOTES:[/h3]
- Yarnaby now spawns correctly
- Yarnaby should no longer spawn camp the player as badly.  Additional fixes coming in next patch.
- Yarnaby's cone of vision reduced.
- Hiding spaces function better during the Yarnaby Boss fight.
- Audio for objective tracker and tooltip should no longer take up multiple channels when restarting from checkpoints.
- Tutorial tooltips now remain on screen longer.
- Flashlight tooltip now displays correctly.
- Fixed several lighting and reflection issues. 
- Other UI Improvements

Thanks!
Mob Entertainment
